title.description: Short issue title only: sentence case, specific about the observed failure, under 80 characters, no environment/module/priority prefix, no trailing period.

description.description: What is broken, in the reporter's own facts. Markdown bullets when there are several threads. Include IDs, tenant, role or user they mentioned.

actual.description: What happens now. One or two lines.

expected.description: What should happen. Empty string if the reporter gave no expectation.

keywords.description: 3 to 5 distinctive search keywords (screen, field, error code) for a duplicate search. Not environment or module words.

relatedApiIds.description: Ids (like a3) of listed API calls that look related to the defect, including ones not attached.

question.description: Empty string, unless the notes are too thin to write a useful issue; then one short question for the reporter.
